purpose: Reference upstream HPLT 3 cleaning/filtering scripts and tools relevant to the Greek HPLT second-pass cleaner.
rule: Do not vendor upstream code here by default; record source, commit, path, checksum, and role. Local cleaning must materialize changed text only as duplicate/shadow records.

sources.name: HPLT/HPLT3.0 README
sources.role: Names the HPLT 3 stack: Trafilatura, OpenLID 2.0, Monotextor, Web Docs Scorer, web-register labels, PII, provenance, global deduplication.

sources.name: warc2text-runner
sources.role: WARC extraction runner for HPLT versions 1-3.

sources.name: monotextor-slurm
sources.role: Monolingual merge, language split, robots, dedup, annotation, filtering, and final clean pipeline.

sources.name: web-docs-scorer
sources.role: Document quality score and subscores used for HPLT WDS sorting/filtering.

stages.upstream_role: Extract textual documents from WARC archives.
stages.residual_gap_for_us: Main-text extraction can still leave site chrome, structured residue, or attached texts.

stages.upstream_role: Merge metadata/text/lang streams and batch documents by detected language.
stages.observed_filter: First language prediction probability below 0.5 is discarded according to README.
stages.residual_gap_for_us: A row can be Greek and still contain non-main-text spans or multiple attached texts.
Compliance filtering does not clean text content.
Document-level dedup does not split one row containing multiple logical documents.

stages.upstream_role: Add IDs, segment LID, monofixer/bifixer text fixes, PII, filter reason, robots status, and WDS scores.
stages.residual_gap_for_us: Document-level filters can miss bounded removable spans inside otherwise useful Greek text.

stages.upstream_role: Keep rows where filter is keep, robots status is allowed, and WDS score is at least 5.
stages.residual_gap_for_us: Final clean is a keep/drop filter, not a repair pass for menus/footers or attached documents.

stages.upstream_role: Compute WDS score and subscores from structural/surface features.
stages.residual_gap_for_us: High WDS does not prove the document is pure main-body Greek text.
